games.homeWinRate.source: FOX Sports "Where has home-field advantage gone" and PFF home-field data: home teams won between 51% and 57% of games in 2021-2024, 53.3% in 2024.
games.homeWinRate.note: Neutral and international sites are left out; ties count half.

games.homeMargin.source: Spec 23.2 (roughly 1.5 to 2.5 points in recent seasons); FOX Sports: the average home margin slid from +2.7 to +1.7 points.
games.homeMargin.note: The spec 17.3 home field model, measured as the mean home margin.

games.pointsPerTeam.source: StatMuse league averages by year 2021-2024 (https://www.statmuse.com/nfl/ask/nfl-league-average-points-per-game-by-year-2001-to-2024): 23.0, 21.9, 21.8, and 22.9 points per team game.
games.pointsPerTeam.note: Regular-season points per team per game, all phases.

games.oneScoreShare.source: NFL Analytics "Half of NFL games are one-score games" (nflanalytic.com): 50.7% of regular-season games since 1999 were decided by 8 or fewer.
games.oneScoreShare.note: Final margin of 8 points or fewer, ties included.

games.closeShare.source: NFL Analytics "Half of NFL games are one-score games": 23.3% decided by 1 to 3 points since 1999.

games.blowoutShare.source: betting.us "NFL Blowout Stats Reveal Parity Problem": 21.6% of games in 2015-2024 were decided by 17 or more (26.9% across 1999-2025).

games.overtimeRate.source: thesportsgeek.com and Wikipedia "List of NFL tied games": 16 overtime games of 272 in 2024 (5.9%); Scott Kacsmar: 21 in 2021 (7.7%).
games.overtimeRate.note: Regular-season games that reach overtime, ties included.

games.tieRate.source: Wikipedia "List of NFL tied games": none in 2023 or 2024, and about one a season (0.4%) since 2012.
games.tieRate.note: Regular-season games that end tied after overtime.

games.comebackRate.source: Scott Kacsmar, "NFL 2021: Close Game Summary" (captaincomeback.blog): 54 to 73 fourth-quarter comeback wins a season in 2017-2021 (about 20% to 26% of games, playoffs included); a record 85 in 2022.
games.comebackRate.note: Measured as the winner trailing at some point in the fourth quarter or overtime.

games.favoriteWinRate.source: ESPN "NFL betting favorites on verge of completing historic season": favorites win about 66% straight up over the long run and won 71.7% in 2024.
games.favoriteWinRate.note: Favorites by fitted team ratings plus home field; each league's ratings are fitted over all its replays, the sim's stand-in for the closing line.

games.favoriteWinRateUnder3.source: Stern's normal model of margins around the spread (sd 13.5 to 13.9): 50% to 59% for spreads under 3; SportingCharts: favorites of 3 or fewer won about half since 2015.
games.favoriteWinRateUnder3.note: Favorites by the fitted rating gap plus home field; ties count half.

games.favoriteWinRate3to7.source: Stern's normal model (sd 13.5 to 13.9): 59% to 70% for spreads of 3 to 7.
games.favoriteWinRate3to7.note: Favorites by the fitted rating gap plus home field; ties count half.

games.favoriteWinRate7to10.source: Stern's normal model (sd 13.5 to 13.9): 70% to 77% for spreads of 7 to 10.
games.favoriteWinRate7to10.note: Favorites by the fitted rating gap plus home field; ties count half.

games.favoriteWinRate10Plus.source: ESPN: favorites of 10 or more win over 80%; Stern's normal model gives 77% at 10 points and more beyond.
games.favoriteWinRate10Plus.note: Favorites by the fitted rating gap plus home field; ties count half.

games.marginSd.source: Hal Stern (1986, 1991): margins around the spread are normal with sd 13.86; 13.59 for 1992-2011 ("The Performance of Betting Lines for Predicting the Outcome of NFL Games", arXiv 1211.4000); about 13.5 recently (nfelo "Margin Probabilities from NFL Spreads").
games.marginSd.note: Final margin minus the fitted rating gap.

seasons.winSd.source: Harvard Sports Analysis Collective, "This NFL season did not have as much parity as you think": the sd of team wins was 3.20 in 2017 and mostly 2.6 to 3.4 in 16-game seasons, about 2.8 to 3.6 over 17 games.
seasons.winSd.note: Judged on weekly-loop seasons (C-20). Pure chance alone gives about 2.06 over 17 games.

seasons.bestRecord.source: NFL standings 2021-2024 (Wikipedia season pages): the best records had 13, 14, 13, and 15 wins.
seasons.bestRecord.note: The mean of each weekly-loop season's most wins, ties counting half (C-20).

seasons.worstRecord.source: NFL standings 2021-2024 (Wikipedia season pages): the worst records had 3, 3, 2, and 3 wins.
seasons.worstRecord.note: Judged on weekly-loop seasons (C-20). Ties count half.

seasons.manyWinsPerDecade.source: NFL standings (Wikipedia season pages): 12 teams won 14 or more of 16 games in 2004-2020 (2004 PIT and NE, 2005 IND, 2006 SD, 2007 NE, 2009 IND, 2010 NE, 2011 GB, 2015 CAR, 2016 NE, 2019 BAL, 2020 KC), about 7 a decade; two won 15 of 17 in 2021-2024.
seasons.manyWinsPerDecade.note: Per 10 weekly-loop seasons (C-20). 14 of 16 is the 16-game equivalent of 15 of 17 (the same 88% of games).

seasons.fewWinsPerDecade.source: NFL standings 2004-2024 (Wikipedia season pages): 18 teams won 2 or fewer, about 8.6 a decade, though only one in the four 17-game seasons.
seasons.fewWinsPerDecade.note: Teams with 2 or fewer wins, per 10 weekly-loop seasons (C-20).

seasons.perfectOrWinlessPer100.source: Spec 23.2: perfect and winless seasons must be extremely rare, a handful per 100 simulated seasons at most. The NFL had four in 1976-2025 (1976 TB, 2007 NE, 2008 DET, 2017 CLE).
seasons.perfectOrWinlessPer100.note: Perfect means no losses or ties; winless means no wins, ties or not. Per 100 weekly-loop seasons (C-20): a rare event, so a full run plays 100 of them.

stats.passAtt.source: StatMuse league averages by year 2021-2024 (https://www.statmuse.com/nfl/ask/nfl-league-average-passing-stats-by-year-2021-to-2024): 34.4, 33.3, 33.7, and 32.7 pass attempts per team game.
stats.passAtt.note: Pass attempts per team game; sacks are not attempts.

stats.cmpPct.source: StatMuse league averages by year 2021-2024 (https://www.statmuse.com/nfl/ask/nfl-league-average-passing-stats-by-year-2021-to-2024): 64.8%, 64.2%, 64.5%, and 65.3%.

stats.ypa.source: StatMuse league averages by year 2021-2024 (https://www.statmuse.com/nfl/ask/nfl-league-average-passing-stats-by-year-2021-to-2024): 7.1, 7.0, 7.0, and 7.1 yards per attempt.
stats.ypa.note: Gross passing yards per attempt (sack yards are not subtracted).

stats.tdPct.source: StatMuse league averages by year 2021-2024 (https://www.statmuse.com/nfl/ask/nfl-league-average-passing-stats-by-year-2021-to-2024): 4.49%, 4.15%, 4.12%, and 4.54% of attempts.

stats.intPct.source: StatMuse league averages by year 2021-2024 (https://www.statmuse.com/nfl/ask/nfl-league-average-passing-stats-by-year-2021-to-2024): 2.35%, 2.31%, 2.35%, and 2.17% of attempts.

stats.sackPct.source: StatMuse league averages by year 2021-2024 (https://www.statmuse.com/nfl/ask/nfl-league-average-passing-stats-by-year-2021-to-2024): sacks per dropback 6.2%, 6.7%, 7.1%, and 6.9%.

stats.rushAtt.source: StatMuse league averages by year 2021-2024 (https://www.statmuse.com/nfl/ask/nfl-league-average-rushing-stats-by-year-2021-to-2024): 26.6, 27.3, 26.8, and 27.0 rush attempts per team game.
stats.rushAtt.note: Rushing attempts per team game, quarterback runs and kneels included.

stats.ypc.source: StatMuse league averages by year 2021-2024 (https://www.statmuse.com/nfl/ask/nfl-league-average-rushing-stats-by-year-2021-to-2024): 4.3, 4.5, 4.2, and 4.4 yards per carry.
stats.ypc.note: Rushing yards per carry, kneels included.

stats.thirdDownPct.source: StatMuse league averages by year 2021-2024 (https://www.statmuse.com/nfl/ask/nfl-league-average-third-down-conversion-percentage-by-year-2021-to-2024): 40.4%, 39.4%, 38.8%, and 39.7%.
stats.thirdDownPct.note: Third downs converted to a first down or a touchdown, penalties included.

stats.fourthDownAtt.source: StatMuse league averages by year 2021-2024 (https://www.statmuse.com/nfl/ask/nfl-league-average-third-down-conversion-percentage-by-year-2021-to-2024): 793, 736, 799, and 766 fourth-down tries, 1.35 to 1.47 per team game.
stats.fourthDownAtt.note: Fourth downs run as plays (not punts or field goals) per team game. Band: the 2021-2024 mean of 1.42 plus or minus 5% (9% for warn).

stats.fourthDownPct.source: StatMuse league averages by year 2021-2024 (https://www.statmuse.com/nfl/ask/nfl-league-average-third-down-conversion-percentage-by-year-2021-to-2024): 53.1%, 50.7%, 51.6%, and 56.8%.
stats.fourthDownPct.note: Fourth-down plays converted. Band: the 2021-2024 mean of 53.1% plus or minus 2 points (3.5 for warn).

stats.redZoneTdPct.source: TeamRankings "Red Zone Scoring Percentage (TD only)": team rates run from the mid 40s to the high 60s (SF led 2023 at 67.2%; TB's 65.7% was fourth in 2024).
stats.redZoneTdPct.note: The league average was behind paywalls and blocked pages, so the band is wide; tighten it when a sourced average is found.

stats.turnovers.source: StatMuse league averages by year 2021-2024 (https://www.statmuse.com/nfl/ask/nfl-league-average-turnovers-and-penalty-yards-per-game-by-year-2021-to-2024): 1.30, 1.31, 1.35, and 1.21 turnovers per team game.
stats.turnovers.note: Interceptions thrown and fumbles lost per team game.

stats.penalties.source: StatMuse league averages by year 2021-2024 (https://www.statmuse.com/nfl/ask/nfl-league-average-penalties-per-game-by-year-2021-to-2024): 5.92, 5.60, 5.71, and 6.44 accepted penalties per team game.

stats.penaltyYds.source: StatMuse league averages by year 2021-2024 (https://www.statmuse.com/nfl/ask/nfl-league-average-turnovers-and-penalty-yards-per-game-by-year-2021-to-2024): 51.0, 46.1, 47.1, and 52.2 penalty yards per team game.
stats.penaltyYds.note: Accepted penalty yards per team game.

stats.fgPctUnder40.source: NFL.com team field goal stats by distance, 2021-2024 regular seasons (https://www.nfl.com/stats/team-stats/special-teams/field-goals/2024/reg/all, and the same page for 2021 to 2023), summed across the 32 teams (season totals 874, 903, 911, and 937 made match StatMuse): 518 of 541 (95.7%), 502 of 531 (94.5%), 534 of 555 (96.2%), and 511 of 535 (95.5%) under 40 yards.
stats.fgPctUnder40.note: Attempts under 40 yards, by the kick distance. Band: the 2021-2024 mean of 95.5% plus or minus 2 points (3.5 for warn).

stats.fgPct40s.source: NFL.com team field goal stats by distance, 2021-2024 regular seasons (https://www.nfl.com/stats/team-stats/special-teams/field-goals/2024/reg/all, and the same page for 2021 to 2023), summed across the 32 teams (season totals 874, 903, 911, and 937 made match StatMuse): 236 of 304 (77.6%), 247 of 307 (80.5%), 219 of 275 (79.6%), and 231 of 301 (76.7%) from 40 to 49 yards.
stats.fgPct40s.note: Band: the 2021-2024 mean of 78.6% plus or minus 2 points (3.5 for warn).

stats.fgPct50Plus.source: NFL.com team field goal stats by distance, 2021-2024 regular seasons (https://www.nfl.com/stats/team-stats/special-teams/field-goals/2024/reg/all, and the same page for 2021 to 2023), summed across the 32 teams (season totals 874, 903, 911, and 937 made match StatMuse): 120 of 182 (65.9%), 154 of 224 (68.8%), 158 of 230 (68.7%), and 195 of 279 (69.9%) from 50 or more.
stats.fgPct50Plus.note: Band: the 2021-2024 mean of 68.3% plus or minus 2 points (3.5 for warn).

stats.puntAvg.source: StatMuse "NFL league average punting stats by year 2021 to 2024" (https://www.statmuse.com/nfl/ask/nfl-league-average-punting-stats-by-year-2021-to-2024): gross averages 45.6, 46.8, 47.3, and 47.3.
stats.puntAvg.note: Gross yards per punt, from the line of scrimmage.

stats.kickoffReturnRate.source: PFF "NFL kickoffs are evolving as returns surged in 2025" and TSN: 74.5% to 76% of kickoffs were returned in 2025, with touchbacks at the 35.
stats.kickoffReturnRate.note: The rule set uses the 2025 kickoff rules.

stats.kickReturnAvg.source: PFF: kick returns averaged 25.9 yards in 2025 and 27.6 in 2024.
stats.kickReturnAvg.note: Yards per kickoff return, touchbacks excluded.

stats.puntReturnAvg.source: StatMuse "NFL league average punt return stats by year 2021 to 2024" (https://www.statmuse.com/nfl/ask/nfl-league-average-punt-return-stats-by-year-2021-to-2024): 8.9, 9.0, 9.6, and 9.9 yards per punt return.
stats.puntReturnAvg.note: Yards per punt return, fair catches excluded.

leaders.passYds.source: Wikipedia "List of NFL annual passing yards leaders" (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_NFL_annual_passing_yards_leaders): the 2021-2025 leaders had 5,316, 5,250, 4,624, 4,918, and 4,707 (mean 4,963); 2014-2025 ranged from 4,577 to 5,316.
leaders.passYds.note: The mean of each replay season's leader. Band: the 17-game-era mean plus or minus 1.5 standard errors of that mean, at least 4% (2.5 and 7% for warn).

leaders.rushYds.source: Wikipedia "List of NFL annual rushing yards leaders" (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_NFL_annual_rushing_yards_leaders): the 2021-2025 leaders had 1,811, 1,653, 1,459, 2,005, and 1,621 (mean 1,710); 2014-2025 ranged from 1,327 to 2,027.
leaders.rushYds.note: The mean of each replay season's leader. Band: the 17-game-era mean plus or minus 1.5 standard errors of that mean, at least 4% (2.5 and 7% for warn).

leaders.recYds.source: Wikipedia "List of NFL annual receiving yards leaders" (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_NFL_annual_receiving_yards_leaders): the 2021-2025 leaders had 1,947, 1,809, 1,799, 1,708, and 1,793 (mean 1,811); 2014-2025 ranged from 1,448 to 1,947.
leaders.recYds.note: The mean of each replay season's leader. Band: the 17-game-era mean plus or minus 1.5 standard errors of that mean, at least 4% (2.5 and 7% for warn).

leaders.receptions.source: Wikipedia "List of NFL annual receptions leaders" (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_NFL_annual_receptions_leaders): the 2021-2025 leaders had 145, 128, 135, 127, and 129 (mean 132.8); 2014-2025 ranged from 107 to 149.
leaders.receptions.note: The mean of each replay season's leader. Band: the 17-game-era mean plus or minus 1.5 standard errors of that mean, at least 4% (2.5 and 7% for warn).

leaders.sacks.source: Wikipedia "List of NFL annual sacks leaders" (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_NFL_annual_sacks_leaders): the 2021-2025 leaders had 22.5, 18.5, 19, 17.5, and 23 (mean 20.1); 2014-2025 ranged from 15 to 23.
leaders.sacks.note: The mean of each replay season's leader. Band: the 17-game-era mean plus or minus 1.5 standard errors of that mean, at least 4% (2.5 and 7% for warn).

leaders.defInt.source: Wikipedia "List of NFL annual interceptions leaders" (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_NFL_annual_interceptions_leaders): the 2021-2025 leaders had 11, 6, 9, 9, and 7 (mean 8.4); 2014-2025 ranged from 6 to 11.
leaders.defInt.note: The mean of each replay season's leader. Band: the 17-game-era mean plus or minus 1.5 standard errors of that mean, at least 4% (2.5 and 7% for warn).

leaders.passers4000.source: Sports Illustrated, "Using sportsbooks to pick 4,000-yard passers": nine in 2022, the fewest since 2017.
leaders.passers4000.note: Per replay season of 17 games; the source's seasons are mostly 16 games, so 17-game counts run a little higher.

leaders.rushers1000.source: FOX Sports (via Wausau Pilot), "1,000-yard rushers are keeping pace with 1,000-yard receivers": 110 1,000-yard rushing seasons in the last decade, about 11 a season, and more in 2024.
leaders.rushers1000.note: Per replay season of 17 games; the decade average is mostly 16-game seasons, so the band sits above it.

leaders.receivers1000.source: FOX Sports (via Wausau Pilot): 233 1,000-yard receiving seasons in the last decade, about 23 a season.
leaders.receivers1000.note: Per replay season of 17 games; the decade average is mostly 16-game seasons, so the band sits above it.

leaders.topTargetShare.source: Fantasy Footballers, "The Path to a WR1 Fantasy Season": a team's WR1 mostly sees 20% or more of its targets, and near 30% is rare.
leaders.topTargetShare.note: The mean of each team's highest share of its own targets.

leaders.maxTargetShare.source: Sharp Football "Odds & Trends: Fantasy Wide Receiver Production Heading Into 2024": three receivers passed a 30% target share in 2023, the most since 2014.
leaders.maxTargetShare.note: The highest target share in the league each replay season, averaged.

leaders.leadBackShare.source: PFF "Examining team running back usage and tendencies for 2024": lead backs took about 50% to 65% of their teams' running back carries.
leaders.leadBackShare.note: The top back's share of his team's running back carries.

injuries.missed.source: Orthopaedic Journal of Sports Medicine, "Injury Rates Remained Elevated in the Second NFL Season After the Onset of the COVID-19 Pandemic" (PMC9742207): injuries costing at least one game numbered about 645 a season in 2018-2020 (20 per team) and 824 in 2021 (25.8 per team).
injuries.missed.note: In-game injuries only until the M7 season loop adds practice injuries and carry-over.

effects.fit.source: Design target, spec 7.3: best versus worst fit for the same player produces meaningful but not dominant stat differences.
effects.fit.note: Meaningful: at least a 4% change in per-play production. Not dominant: at most 15%. Mean of the six groups, each measured as the change from the worst arm to the best.

effects.windPoints.source: NFL Analytics "Weather & NFL Scoring: It's the Wind" (7,276 games, 1999-2025): outdoor games average 44.7 total points in calm air (0-5 mph) and 40.5 at 16 mph or more, 2.1 fewer per team.
effects.windPoints.note: Outdoor games only: points per team at 16 mph or more minus at 5 mph or less.

effects.domePoints.source: NFL Analytics "Weather & NFL Scoring": domes and closed roofs average 46.9 total points against 43.4 outdoors, 1.75 more per team.
effects.domePoints.note: Points per team indoors minus outdoors.

effects.coldPoints.source: NFL Analytics "Weather & NFL Scoring": 43.4 total points at 32°F or colder (384 games) against 43.7 at 50-69°F, about the same.
effects.coldPoints.note: Outdoor games only: points per team at 32°F or colder minus at 50 to 69°F.

effects.windCompletion.source: The Spax, "Analyzing the Effect of Weather in the NFL": completion rate 60.3% with wind under 10 mph and 54.7% at 20 mph or more.
effects.windCompletion.note: Outdoor games only: completion rate at 20 mph or more minus under 10 mph.

effects.windFieldGoal.source: The Spax, "Analyzing the Effect of Weather in the NFL": field goals 83.8% with wind under 10 mph and 76.9% at 20 mph or more.
effects.windFieldGoal.note: Outdoor games only: field goal rate at 20 mph or more minus under 10 mph.
